one_liner: Will rank every number by how well its usual gap between appearances lines up with the target draw.
registry_status_reason: Method specification not yet written and ratified (R2 section 7.1).
short_explanation: E_2 will look, for each number, at the gaps between its past appearances, estimate its typical gap, and project whether its next appearance falls at the target draw: the projected interval at the target, not simply how long the number has been missing. Different ways of estimating the gap (mean, median, mode, hazard or a mixture) will be separate named variants, and numbers never yet seen need a stated rule. Its specification is not yet written, so it cannot run.
